author: kojokers
body:
minecraft name kojokers

I was just wrongly tempbanned from legokee for apparently team griefing when i never griefed anything from my team. What i did in the map was win teammate charliebobs from the person who had obtained it from him which is not griefing i handed charliebob a spare full set of iron armour that i had earnt through kills. also no one on my team even accused me of team griefing and Legokee was on the other team and i never even joined the blue team during that match and unlike most team griefings that take place there was not a single complaint from a player that anybody was team griefing. Also whether you overturn this infraction or not i will not accept it on my infractions list if the appeal is rejected because this is the most bs tempban i have recieved.

please make sure that justice is done and that this unjustified appeal is overturned and that is a #ODRfact

title: appealing infraction

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

Since you have shown no evidence that the infraction was false it shall not be appealed.

I assure you that the Mod Legokee would not abuse the powers of mod for personal gain.

If you believe that is the case you need to compile evidence that supports your claim and send that to our support email.

Also there is no reason real to appeal a 1 day tempban. Better off just waiting it out.
